intro: This Editor Manual provides comprehensive guidance for contributing to the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) Technical Library. It details the workflow for document creation, editing, publishing, and migrating existing content, explaining Git subtree integration. The manual covers essential aspects such as document lifecycle management, file naming conventions, YAML header configuration, content formatting, and document licensing policies. It also outlines procedures for local previewing, publishing, and document version management, alongside detailed guidelines on Quarto's advanced features, including structured reference management using BibTeX and custom heading numbering, ensuring consistent and efficient documentation practices for all contributors.
